company_info.industry_info: Software Development - Design, Editing & Rendering Software Publishing, specifically 3D design software, digital prototyping, and cloud platforms. Autodesk creates software for designers, engineers, builders, and creators across architecture, construction, manufacturing, and media & entertainment industries.
company_info.recent_news: Autodesk announced in January 2026 a 7% workforce reduction (approximately 1,000 employees) as part of ongoing restructuring efforts. This follows a 9% reduction announced in 2025. The company is undergoing strategic shifts including simplifying customer engagement, expanding AI and platform leadership, and realigning investments. Despite layoffs, Autodesk expects revenue and cash flow to exceed guidance. The company recently raised $1.5B in Post IPO debt funding in June 2025.
company_info.company_culture: Autodesk has a 4.0 out of 5 star rating on Glassdoor based on 4,648 reviews, with 80% of employees recommending the company to a friend. The company is recognized for an inclusive and supportive atmosphere with a collaborative work environment. Remote work options are available. Work-life balance is rated 4.2 out of 5. The culture emphasizes diversity and belonging, with a focus on meaningful work that helps build a better world.
company_info.any_related_information: This is an early-career/new graduate focused role (Job Requisition ID: 25WD91160) designed to provide mentorship and hands-on learning. The role emphasizes learning cloud platform development, distributed systems, and microservices architecture. Autodesk is a public company (NASD: ADSK) with 2025 revenue of $7.2B and is headquartered in San Francisco. The company was founded in 1982 and has 10,000+ employees worldwide. CEO Andrew Anagnost has assured employees that recent layoffs are not indicative of a yearly pattern or a shift toward replacing workers with AI.
